newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Reforms boost Australia car industry - report.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Reforms boost Australia car industry - report.

text.p: Australian Industry Minister John Moore said on Thursday the automotive industry had responded well to increased competition stemming from microeconomic reform.
"Strong gains have been made in terms of productivity and further microeconomic reform is essential if this progress is to be sustained," Moore said in a statement.
But he said a new government report showed that productivity was not the only issue facing the automotive industry.
"The industry has faced substantial pressures from rationalisation and downsizing in recent years," he said.

"If we are to maximise the potential for future development in the industry we must not only push on with further microeconomic reform ... we must also confront the issue of improved market access for Australian automotive exports."
The Productivity Commission report also found that many car producers were concerned that the positive effects of the reforms had not offset the impact of tariff reductions.

But Moore said this was no reason to reassess the current schedule of tariff reform. "It is a reason to redouble our efforts in all areas of microeconomic reform and to continue to push other countries to open up their markets," he said.
